comments.body:
It looks to me that you need to update your XCode toolchain, you are on `AppleClang 7.3.0.7030031`, and up to date is `AppleClang 9.1.0.9020039`.

If you can't update the toolchain, I suggest that you remove the `-Werror` flag and live with the warnings.
After updating Mac OS to Sierra and updating Xcode, I could compile the SDK.

I am sorry, but I have not been a Mac user for a long time and I can't help
debugging this issue for now.
